objective: Add a controller-owned bounded AI engineering step behind the existing deterministic bootstrap and manifest verification boundary.
acceptance: The model cannot be invoked until the current manifest has been independently re-verified.
Live model calls use the OpenAI Responses API with strict structured output, store disabled, and repository-configured bounds.
Every proposal is bound to the manifest run_id and exact Git commit before mutation.
Only full-file replacements inside allowed_scope can be applied; forbidden, ignored, symlinked, oversized, or unexpected mutations are rejected.
Required verification gates are controller-owned and cannot be removed or altered by model output.
Failed candidate verification is rolled back before a bounded retry; repeated identical failure and retry exhaustion stop deterministically.
NEEDS_MORE_CONTEXT, ARCHITECTURE_CONTRADICTION, UNKNOWN_ENVIRONMENT, and BLOCKED stop without repository mutation.
Missing credentials, malformed output, model unavailability, stale manifests, dirty worktrees, unknown verification gates, and verifier-created mutations stop safely.
A network-free fixture path exercises the same mutation and verification controller on a tiny Android bootstrap change without claiming a live OpenAI invocation.
Checkpoint 3 remains isolated on a candidate branch and draft pull request until its CI evidence is reviewed.
